deadline.value: No fixed deadline unless an external funder sets one; applications are welcome at any time of year.
deadline.quote: Not fixed, unless determined by external funding bodies. We welcome applications at any time of the year.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: You must name at least one potential supervisor on the application, so contact staff before applying.
supervisor.quote: Applicants must specify at least one potential supervisor.

funding.value: Funding comes from research councils, industry and Bristol scholarships; there is no separate application for most of these.
funding.quote: The School of Chemistry offers financial support for PhD students from a range of sources, including UK research councils, Industry, Bristol Postgraduate Research Scholarships, and other scholarship schemes.

entry_route.value: Normally an upper-second MSci/MChem or an MSc; a good BSc may be considered if you show research potential.
entry_route.quote: A minimum of an upper second-class MSci/MChem honours degree in chemistry, or a relevant related discipline, or a postgraduate MSc or international equivalent. | We may consider applicants with a lower second-class MSci/MChem honours degree, or a first or upper second-class BSc honours degree who can demonstrate good potential for research.

toefl_min.value: English profile F. TOEFL iBT tests from 21 Jan 2026: 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills (older tests: 83 overall).
toefl_min.quote: For tests taken from 21 January 2026 onwards: 4.5 overall with 4.5 in all skills

also.quote: If English is not your first language, you will need to reach the requirements outlined in our profile level F.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.0 overall, with listening or speaking at 6.5 and no score below 6.0 (profile F).
ielts_min.quote: 6.0 overall with either listening or speaking at 6.5, with no score below 6.0

also.quote: If English is not your first language, you will need to reach the requirements outlined in our profile level F.

notes: Admissions statement quoted is for 2026 entry.
